title: Not universal
text: Not universal. I hope you done need these because they are a pain in my butt. None of the holes matched up with our current bed frame and we had to do a lot of drilling to make it work.

product_metadata.title: MALOUF Structures Bolt-on Footboard Extension Brackets Attachment Kit (Set of 2), Twin-King, Black
features: Footboard extension brackets compatible with Structures bed frames; designed for Twin-King size beds.
Easily attach bolt-on footboard to headboard-only bed frame for extra length.
Simple hardware assembly goes together in minutes.
Provides extra secure connections, reducing shifting and squeaking.
Compatibility not guaranteed with bed frames by other manufacturers.
description: Bolt-on footboard extension brackets allow you to extend a standard length, headboard-only bed frame to attach a bolt-on footboard. Kit includes 2 footboard extensions, 6 lock nuts, 6 carriage bolts, and 6 washers for a quick assembly and a secure connection. This attachment is compatible with the Structures Universal bed frame, Adjustable Full/Twin bed frame, Adjustable Queen/Full/Twin bed frame, and Low-Profile Adjustable bed frame. While brackets may fit many bed frames by other manufacturers, we cannot guarantee compatibility.
